description: This file declares classes, functions, and data structures related to the Kineto profiler events in PyTorch's autograd profiler module, including KinetoEvent, ProfilerResult, and functions for enabling/disabling the profiler and reporting backend events.

classes.name: KinetoEvent
classes.description: Represents a profiling event with various attributes such as thread IDs, activity type, shapes, data types, inputs, and metadata.

classes.name: ProfilerResult
classes.description: Encapsulates the result of a profiling session, including events, trace data, and methods to save the profiling data.

methods.name: KinetoEvent
methods.description: Constructor for KinetoEvent, initializes with a result and verbosity flag.

methods.name: ProfilerResult
methods.description: Constructors and destructor for ProfilerResult, managing profiling data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the profiling result to a specified file path.
